version_rules.allowed_release_versions: v0.MINOR.PATCH or v0.MINOR.PATCH-rc.N; MINOR >= 1, N >= 1; no build metadata, branch, latest or offline batch versions
version_rules.patch: Compatible corrections only; no removal, signature/field/interface break or newly required caller behavior.
version_rules.minor: New API or intentional breaking change during v0; describe migration, protocol/behavior and resource effects explicitly.
version_rules.prerelease: Increment rc.N for any changed candidate; no stable compatibility promise.
version_rules.v1: Requires separate reviewed readiness decision; this policy does not authorize v1.
version_rules.immutability: Never move, overwrite or reuse a published tag/version. Retract a bad version in a newer release; preserve old content. Record commit and checksum receipts.

api_review.scope: All exported non-internal library packages in both modules, generated declarations, errors, interfaces, ownership/cancellation/resource contracts; protocol slice versions are separate.
api_review.gate: Exact documentation/source snapshot drift requires explicit review; snapshot equality does not prove semantic compatibility. Never auto-refresh in CI.

installation.replace: forbidden in consumer and downloaded module manifests and graph
installation.cache: fresh private GOMODCACHE, GOCACHE and GOPATH for each core-only and adapter consumer
installation.core_dependency: adapter must require exactly the tested, already published core version; MVS upgrade is an error
installation.acceptance: Remote tag commits, authenticated downloads, exact graph, go mod verify, reviewed API, public consumer pure/race execution; all required for passed.
installation.checkout_checks: Temporary workspace checks remain separate; offline candidate/proxy/cache is never release evidence.

next_release.version_rationale: Changed v0 candidate: selected combined SMS, unit, indicator, equipment-type and address-type Receive diagnostics, slice.20 and Bundle fingerprints. Public signatures/layouts unchanged. Future adapter candidate must pin the new published core before installation acceptance.
